resources.string: Two purposes: (1) Read the pairing code from Android's Wireless debugging dialog, so you do not have to copy a code that expires after two minutes. (2) Let the AI assistant read the screen, tap, type, press keys and take screenshots (Android 11+), enabling device control without ADB or Shizuku.\n\nDSHA does not record your screen in the background: screen contents are read only when the assistant explicitly requests them, returned directly to the conversation, and not saved or uploaded. Pairing codes are read only during the two minutes after you tap Auto-read pairing code.
